_meta.description: Templates de prompts pour gpt-image-1 (et fallback dall-e-3) — utilisés par src/server/content-gen/images/image-prompt-builder.ts. Ingéré Sprint 2.
_meta.doctrine: Palette intouchable terracotta #C45A3E + crème #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Style éditorial sobre. Pas de visage photoréaliste (RGPD). Pas de logos tiers.

templates.name: Hero landing ville
templates.template: Editorial illustration of {ville_name}, France ({region_name}). Urban architecture meets operational AI visualization: subtle data-flow lines, geometric grid suggesting algorithmic structure, blended with recognizable but stylized urban silhouette (rooftops, civic landmark if any). Style: minimalist editorial poster, flat-color, no photorealism, no human faces, no third-party logos. Color palette strictly: terracotta #C45A3E for accent, cream #FAF7F2 for background, ink #1F1B16 for outlines. Soft texture, slightly grained. Square 1024×1024. Mood: thoughtful, professional, French sober elegance.

templates.name: Section méthodologie landing ville
templates.template: Editorial illustration of a structured 3-step methodology process. Three connected geometric elements representing: 1) discovery (magnifying glass abstract), 2) audit (layered document stack), 3) implementation (gear meeting upward arrow). Vertical or horizontal flow. Style: minimalist editorial, flat-color, no humans, no logos. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Hero article blog (défaut)
templates.template: Editorial illustration for an article titled « {title_short} ». Theme: {category} in operational AI for {audience_label}. Abstract conceptual visual representing the main idea: {primary_concept}. Style: minimalist editorial poster, geometric shapes, flat-color, no photorealism, no human faces, no logos. Palette strictly: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Soft grain texture. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Hero article cas d'usage
templates.template: Editorial illustration of a concrete use case scenario in operational AI: {use_case_label}. Visual metaphor: a workflow transforming raw input (left) into clean structured output (right) via an algorithmic process in the middle. Abstract geometric, no humans, no logos. Style: minimalist editorial. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Hero article stratégie
templates.template: Editorial illustration representing strategic decision-making in operational AI: a fork in the road or a balance scale weighing options (e.g., RAG vs fine-tuning, internalization vs externalization, SaaS vs custom). Abstract geometric, sober, no humans, no logos. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024. Mood: thoughtful, executive-grade.

templates.name: Hero article méthodologie
templates.template: Editorial illustration of a structured methodology with numbered steps (3, 5 or 7 steps depending on context). Each step represented as a geometric shape in sequence (circles connected by lines, or stacked rectangles). Style: minimalist editorial flowchart, no humans, no logos. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Hero comparatif
templates.template: Editorial illustration comparing 2 to 6 entities side by side. Visual: balanced scale or split-screen showing {item_a} vs {item_b} (and additional items if applicable). Each entity represented as a stylized abstract shape (different geometric form per entity). Style: minimalist editorial, sober, no humans, no third-party logos (abstract shapes only). Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Hero guide pilier
templates.template: Editorial illustration for a long-form pillar guide on « {topic} » in operational AI. Visual: an open book or layered manuscript with abstract geometric chapter markers, suggesting depth and authority. Style: minimalist editorial, executive publishing quality, no humans, no logos. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024. Mood: reference-grade, authoritative.

templates.name: Hero FAQ thématique
templates.template: Editorial illustration representing a curated FAQ section on the theme « {topic} ». Visual: a clean question mark made of stacked thin geometric shapes, or a series of small horizontal lines suggesting Q&A entries. Style: minimalist editorial, sober, no humans, no logos. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Hero actualité RSS
templates.template: Editorial illustration for a news article on « {topic} » in AI sector. Visual: a stylized newspaper headline shape or a horizontal divider line with a single accent geometric element (circle or triangle) representing the news subject. Style: minimalist editorial press, sober, no humans, no logos. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024. Mood: current, factual.

templates.name: Illustration milieu de section (générique)
templates.template: Subtle editorial illustration to break the visual rhythm mid-article on theme « {section_theme} ». Visual: a single abstract geometric shape or small pattern (e.g., 3 dots connecting to a central node, a soft arc, an inscribed shape). Style: very minimalist, almost like a typographic ornament. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024 but designed to be visually light.

templates.name: Illustration cas concret anonymisé
templates.template: Editorial illustration of an anonymized case study scenario: a stylized business sector ({sector_label}) at company size {size_label}, with a before/after transformation. Visual: two parallel geometric arrangements showing « before » (cluttered) and « after » (clean structured). No specific company logos, no recognizable buildings, no human faces. Style: minimalist editorial. Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Illustration table tarifs (visuel)
templates.template: Editorial illustration suggesting tiered pricing without showing actual numbers: three or four stacked geometric blocks of increasing size representing tier levels (Flash → Ciblé → Stratégique). Each tier has a different shade within the terracotta-cream palette. Style: minimalist editorial diagram, no text, no logos. Palette strictly: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024.

templates.name: Hero page Q/R indexable
templates.template: Small editorial illustration for an individual Q/R page on theme « {qa_question_short} ». Visual: a single stylized speech bubble made of thin geometric lines, or a compact dialog mark. Style: very minimalist, lightweight (page is short — visual should not dominate). Palette: terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16. Square 1024×1024 (cropped 16:9 at render).

templates.name: Placeholder fallback (si gpt-image-1 down)
templates.template: [NE PAS APPELER LLM — utiliser composant React <IllustrationPlaceholder /> existant directement dans le code. Slot ID + target filename générés. Palette terracotta + cream uniquement. Géré côté code, pas LLM.]
templates.notes: Pas un vrai prompt — c'est le fallback CSS/SVG du composant existant. Documenté ici pour la complétude.

rules: Palette stricte : terracotta #C45A3E + cream #FAF7F2 + ink #1F1B16 (rappelé dans CHAQUE prompt)
Pas de bâtiment précisément reconnaissable (ex tour Eiffel évidente — risque copyright + cliché)
Style minimaliste éditorial, pas de photoréalisme
willActions: 1. Tester chaque template avec 1-2 valeurs réelles avant Sprint 2
2. Ajuster les wording anglais si gpt-image-1 ne comprend pas bien (essayer FR pur)
3. Documenter les seeds qui produisent les meilleurs résultats visuels
4. Ajouter templates si nouveaux types de contenu apparaissent V2
_validation.qualityCheck: Après génération, vérifier visuellement : palette respectée + aucun humain + aucun logo + style cohérent doctrine v3.3 hero schema.
